columns_never_fillable.column: gross_revenue / net_property_income for JV & associate properties (One Raffles Quay, Marina Bay Financial Centre, 8 Chifley Square, David Malcolm Justice Centre)
columns_never_fillable.reason: These 4 properties are equity-accounted (held via associates/joint ventures: ORQPL, BFCDLLP, CBDPL, Mirvac 8 Chifley Trust, Mirvac (Old Treasury) Trust). The financial statements consolidate only Keppel REIT's 'share of results of associates and joint ventures' ($124,634k) as a single line; no per-property consolidated gross revenue or NPI is disclosed. Only ATTRIBUTABLE NPI per property is given in the factsheets (ORQ $46.3m, MBFC $112.3m, 8 Chifley $9.2m, DMJC $14.5m) and aggregated in Note 32 by holding vehicle. Left null to keep value_basis clean; attributable NPI captured in property note.
Only NLA is disclosed (Attributable NLA per factsheet); gross lettable area is not separately reported anywhere in the AR.
Tenant business sector analysis is disclosed only at portfolio level (by committed gross rent and by committed NLA, p43); no per-property trade-mix breakdown.
Annual report discloses distribution periods, DPU and financial-calendar payment dates but not ex-dividend dates.

parsing_traps: DUAL-BASIS NPI (trap #8, Keppel REIT's signature): consolidated NPI = $215.905m (directly-held only) vs attributable NPI = $381.364m (incl. JV/associate proportionate share + rental support). Stored consolidated as performance.net_property_income; attributable recorded as alternative in performance.note + data_with_no_home.

PORTFOLIO VALUE: headline $11.7b / $11,657,085k INCLUDES JV/associate proportionate interests (per pinned definition). Balance-sheet 'Investment properties, at valuation' = $5,573,016k (directly-held only). Used the headline.

DUAL-BASIS VALUATIONS (trap #7): Portfolio Statement prints carrying value at 100% interest for OFC ($2,880,000k), T Tower ($271,346k), KR Ginza II ($86,351k) while the Valuation table prints Keppel REIT's effective-interest value (2,301,120 / 269,665 / 85,030). Stored effective-interest as market_valuation (matches headline portfolio), 100% as alt_value.

VALUATION incl./excl. rental support & tenant incentives: 2 Blue Street, 255 George Street, Top Ryde valuations are printed both incl. (valuation table) and excl. (Portfolio Statement). Stored incl. as market_valuation, excl. as alt_value.

MBFC granularity mismatch: Portfolio Statement / valuation table split MBFC into two lines (T1&2+MBLM $1,917,700k one-third; T3 $2,934,700k two-third) but the factsheet and segment Note 32 treat MBFC as ONE property/vehicle group (attributable NPI $112.3m combined). Recorded MBFC as a single property row with market_valuation = sum of the two effective-interest lines ($4,852,400k); noted the split and the dual lease expiries (2104 vs 2106).

MBFC Tower 3 ownership change ON the FYE: additional one-third interest acquired 31 Dec 2025 raising T3 from one-third to two-third; the year's results (NPI) still reflect one-third for the full period (Financial Review p62). Acquisition recorded in property_transactions.
Top Ryde City Shopping Centre acquired 19 Dec 2025 -> consolidated GR=NPI=$0.699m is a ~12-day stub, NOT annualised (trap #17).

PROPERTY COUNT: AR consistently says '14 assets' / '14 properties'. The Portfolio Statement lists 10 directly-held + 5 JV/associate property LINES (ORQ, MBFC T1&2+MBLM, MBFC T3, 8 Chifley, DMJC), but MBFC is one property -> 14 distinct properties. properties.json has 14 rows.

DISTRIBUTABLE INCOME layering (trap #12): headline 'Distribution to Unitholders' $212.406m (incl. Anniversary Distribution) vs 'Income available for distribution to Unitholders' $320.277m (incl. $107,871k opening balance). Took headline $212.406m as net_distributable_income.

Multi-currency purchase prices: AUD/KRW/JPY originals with SGD equivalents both printed; recorded transaction price in the original transaction currency per record (trap #16). Disclosed FYE FX: A$1=S$0.8493, KRW1,000=S$0.8830, JPY100=S$0.8303.

reconciliation.fx_rate_disclosed: A$1 = S$0.8493; KRW 1,000 = S$0.8830; JPY 100 = S$0.8303 (all as at 31 December 2025). Prior-year (2024): A$1 = S$0.8799; KRW 1,000 = S$0.9400; JPY 100 = S$0.8915. Reconciliation note: sum_property GR/NPI covers the 10 CONSOLIDATED (directly-held) properties only and reconciles exactly to the reported consolidated totals (Property income $274,478k / NPI $215,905k, Note 32 p177). The 4 JV/associate properties (ORQ, MBFC, 8 Chifley, DMJC) are equity-accounted and EXCLUDED from the consolidated sum (trap #9); their attributable NPI ($46.3m + $112.3m + $9.2m + $14.5m) flows through 'share of results of associates and joint ventures' and the attributable-NPI metric ($381.4m), not the consolidated GR/NPI line.
